name: NEON_GREEN.DOC
source:
A strange file sits in a sea of word documents in a "writings" folder, titled NEON_GREEN.

Take a peek into the life of Ciar Doe alongside another's life beyond the screen.

[From [url=https://compulsivecomputer.itch.io/neon-greendoc]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在“写作”文件夹浩如烟海的Word文档之中，静静躺着一份名为“NEON_GREEN”的古怪文件。

窥探希尔·多伊的生活，同时也一窥屏幕彼端另一个人的人生吧。

[摘自[url=https://compulsivecomputer.itch.io/neon-greendoc]itch.io[/url]]
